# The goldens of the case files that the runners compare with and that are not recorded, one
# <case id>/<subtest> per line, where <subtest> is the path of the subtest that compares the golden below the
# case: a request name, a step name with its observation suffix, upload-1, declare-the-domain, or a request
# name followed by /pip-calls. The api-version golden of a file with standVersion is listed as
# <test method>/api-version. They are grouped by case file. TestCaseFiles_EveryComparedGoldenIsRecorded fails
# on a golden that is not recorded and not listed here, and on a listed golden that is recorded. Recording a
# listed golden removes its line. Why each is missing is not known without a stand run: a run that skipped
# it, or a round not recorded yet.
